items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met Grant Green. We had a nice group.

ctx.x: I don’t know how I met John. It was in New York. I met John Patton, Ben Dixon and Grant Green. We had a nice group. Nice group. I met Grant in East St. Louis, Illinois. In fact, I’m the one who brought him to New York.
